story_title: mobile chat 風 UI (MVP) for claude-tui tab
notes: Test framework: palmux2 が採用している Python + Playwright (.py)。 gui-spec の TS テンプレートは不採用
E2E は palmux2 ローカル binary を go run で起動 + --claude-bin /bin/cat の hermetic 構成 (S7ce250 の踏襲)、 Playwright context を mobile viewport で初期化
Mock test は in-process fake WS (asyncio + websockets) で grid frame と role event を canned 配信、 file:// static harness 経由で MobileChatView を駆動 — S7ce250 の mock test と同じパターン
Backend 依存: S0fd64b-2 (grid diff WS) と S0fd64b-3 (role event) が landed していること。 これら Story が WAVE 順で先 (B-1 → B-2/B-3 → B-4)
Chat 抽出ロジックは MVP — grid の最終 user prompt (行頭 `> `) と直後の行群を assistant 応答として切り出すヒューリスティック。 brittle 前提
state_diagram_mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Connecting: page load (viewport < 600px)
    Connecting --> Connected: ws open + grid.init received
    Connecting --> Disconnected: ws error/close before grid.init
    Connected --> Active: role event role='active'
    Connected --> Viewer: role event role='viewer'
    Active --> Viewer: another client took active (role event)
    Viewer --> Active: user typed + tapped Send (server transfers active)
    Active --> Disconnected: ws close
    Viewer --> Disconnected: ws close
    Disconnected --> Connecting: user taps Reconnect / route revisit

states.name: Connecting
states.description: WebSocket handshake in progress; grid.init not yet received

states.name: Connected (no role yet)
states.description: WS open + grid.init received but role event not arrived. Brief transient state.

states.name: Active
states.description: User is the active client; can send input. Bubbles render from grid extraction.

states.name: Viewer
states.description: Another client is active; this client is read-only. Bubbles still render.

ui_affordances.input: disabled with placeholder 'Another client is typing — type to take control'

states.name: Disconnected
states.description: WS closed; last frame retained on screen. Tap Reconnect to retry.

scenarios.name: Happy path: connect → send → bubble appears
steps: Open http://<host>/{repoId}/{branchId}/claude-tui in a mobile-width browser context (viewport 375x667)
Page mounts the claude-tui tab; useViewport returns 'mobile'; MobileChatView renders (NOT xterm.js)
WS connects to /tabs/claude-tui/attach?mode=grid
Server emits grid.init then role event role='active' (singleton client)
data-testid=mobile-chat-view is visible; role badge displays 'Active'
Tap textarea (data-testid=mobile-chat-input), type 'echo hi-from-mobile'
Send button (data-testid=mobile-chat-send-btn) becomes enabled
Tap Send: input sent as binary frame; textarea clears
claude-bin /bin/cat echoes the bytes back through PTY → grid
After 1s a data-testid=mobile-chat-bubble appears containing 'echo hi-from-mobile'

scenarios.name: Multi-client role transition
steps: Open two mobile browser contexts (Context A and Context B) at /{repoId}/{branchId}/claude-tui
Context A connects first → role='active'
Context B connects → role='viewer' (Context A remains active)
In Context B, role badge shows 'Viewer'; input is disabled
In Context B, tap textarea + type → input becomes enabled (override placeholder)
In Context B, tap Send → server transfers active to B → both contexts receive role event
Context A badge now shows 'Viewer'; Context B badge shows 'Active'

scenarios.name: Disconnection + reconnect
steps: Open mobile chat, become Active
Server-side: kill the WS connection (test harness closes mid-stream)
Status transitions to Disconnected; reconnect button visible
Tap Reconnect → status returns to Connecting → Connected → Active
Bubble history is restored from server's ring buffer replay

scenarios.name: Empty input edge case
steps: Become Active with empty conversation
Send button is disabled when input is empty
Type 1 char → Send becomes enabled
Backspace to empty → Send becomes disabled

endpoint_contracts.registered_note: Existing endpoint from S7ce250-2. Sprint B-2 ADDS a `?mode=grid` query param to switch frame format; without the param, behavior is unchanged (raw bytes, backward compatible).

response_fields.grid_mode (?mode=grid): JSON frames: {type:'grid.init'|'grid.diff', cols, rows, cursor:{x,y}, altScreen, rows:[{y, cells:[{ch, fg?, bg?, attrs?}]}]} and {type:'role', role:'active'|'viewer', since:<unix-ms>}

auto_decisions.rationale: palmux2 全体の規約 (tests/e2e/*.py + tests/e2e/mobile/conftest.py の mobile_context helper) を踏襲
MOBILE_MAX=599 を下回り、 既存 mobile/conftest.py のデフォルトと整合
S0fd64b-4 は backend (S0fd64b-2/-3) の grid モード経路を必要とする。 mobile_context だけだと dev server に依存して再現性が落ちる

auto_decisions.topic: chat bubble 抽出アルゴリズム
auto_decisions.decision: grid 最終 user prompt (行頭 `> `) を境界として、 その直後から alt-screen 末端までを assistant 応答として 1 つのバブルにする。 history はすべての user/assistant ペアを順次バブル化
auto_decisions.rationale: MVP として brittle で許容。 transcript JSONL からの構造化抽出は将来 Sprint で代替

auto_decisions.decision: Send button のみ (Enter キーは改行)
auto_decisions.rationale: mobile soft keyboard で Enter = 改行 が自然。 mobile bottom-sheet で send ボタンは指で押せる位置

auto_decisions.decision: Connecting/Disconnected では非表示、 Active/Viewer の 2 状態のみ表示
auto_decisions.rationale: ユーザに役立たない transient state を隠す
